_comment: Whole-store refusal baseline for ACS-100i-7. Records the refusal messages that are NOT attributable to the top-level package-surface if/then rule. The guard test asserts this set is byte-identical: none added, none removed, no message changed. A shrunken set normally means validation was loosened generally instead of the trigger narrowed. REGENERATED 2026-08-25: the original 37-record baseline was measured at 9b16d013 before PR #518 narrowed the trigger. PR #493 then legitimately FIXED 9 of those 37 records by adding the required components list to nine ux-prototyping ACs, each of whose sole refusal message was "components is a required property". Their disappearance is a repair, not a loosening — every other refusal, including the untouched UXP records failing on test_spec shape, is unchanged. Regenerate ONLY in a commit that can point at the record edit explaining each removal; never to make a red assertion go green.
